adjustments.description: Settlement of a commercial dispute. Non-recurring.
adjustments.management_rationale: Settlement of commercial dispute - non-recurring. Management advises this relates to a separate matter from FY2023 and FY2024 settlements.
adjustments.reasoning: The identical settlement category, identical amount ($2,100,000), and identical rationale ('Settlement of commercial dispute - non-recurring') appear in each of FY2023 (ADJ-001), FY2024 (ADJ-002), and FY2025 (ADJ-003). SQL-EV-023 confirms three occurrences across three consecutive fiscal years, each at exactly $2,100,000. Board minutes (DOC-09, Item 7) provide contemporaneous governance evidence that directly contradicts management's non-recurring classification: the CFO reported 'the third annual settlement under the ongoing series of commercial disputes with former channel partners had been concluded at $2.1M, consistent with the prior two years' and the Board asked 'whether provision should be made for a further settlement in FY2026.' The Board's own language — 'third annual settlement', 'ongoing series', 'consistent with prior two years', and the question about FY2026 provision — establishes that this is a recurring economic pattern, not a one-time event. The underlying economic event (settlement payment) is real and the amount is confirmed, but the EBITDA add-back is rejected because the evidence demonstrates an ongoing recurring pattern that is inappropriate for normalized historical EBITDA.

existence.detail: Board minutes (DOC-09, Item 7) confirm the FY2025 settlement was concluded at $2.1M. Structured data (SQL-EV-002) confirms ADJ-003 in the adjustment table.

amount.detail: Board minutes state '$2.1M, consistent with the prior two years.' Structured data shows $2,100,000. Amount is confirmed.

period.detail: ADJ-003 is recorded as FY2025 in structured data and QoE schedule. Board minutes dated October 2025 confirm the settlement was concluded in the current period.

recurrence.detail: SQL-EV-023: Three occurrences across FY2023, FY2024, FY2025, each at exactly $2,100,000. Board minutes (DOC-09, Item 7) describe 'the third annual settlement under the ongoing series of commercial disputes' and the Board asked about FY2026 provision. This is a recurring annual cost pattern.

duplication.detail: ADJ-001 and ADJ-002 are historical-period adjustments not applied to FY2025. ADJ-003 is the sole FY2025 legal settlement adjustment.

underlying_data.detail: No invoice or transaction record for the settlement payment exists in the structured sources. The settlement is a cost item, not a revenue transaction.

adjustments.description: Founder salary above market; normalised to a market rate for the role.
adjustments.management_rationale: Founder salary above market; normalised to market rate. Supported by a third-party compensation benchmark dated Sep-2025.
adjustments.reasoning: Owner compensation normalisation is a standard and conceptually appropriate QoE adjustment for private equity transactions. Management states the adjustment is supported by a third-party compensation benchmark dated September 2025. The adjustment amount ($1,250,000) is consistent across the management QoE schedule and structured data. No available evidence contradicts the amount or the QoE treatment. The adjustment is not recurring in the QoE sense — it represents the above-market portion of founder compensation that would not persist under new ownership at market rates. No historical recurrence of this adjustment category appears in the structured data for prior years. The absence of the third-party benchmark document in the data room reduces confidence but does not override acceptance given the conceptual appropriateness of the adjustment, the consistency of the amount across authoritative sources, and the absence of contradicting evidence. The evidence limitation is disclosed and reflected in confidence.

existence.detail: Adjustment present in both structured data (SQL-EV-001) and management QoE schedule (DOC-08). Owner compensation normalisation is a standard QoE adjustment category.

amount.detail: $1,250,000 appears consistently in structured data and QoE schedule. Third-party benchmark referenced by management (Sep-2025) is not in the data room. No alternative amount derivable from available evidence.

duplication.detail: No other adjustment in FY2025 covers owner or founder compensation. ADJ-009 covers executive search fees which is a distinct category.

underlying_data.detail: Payroll or compensation data is not available in the structured sources. The adjustment cannot be independently reconstructed from available data.

adjustments.what_would_raise_confidence: Third-party compensation benchmark document (Sep-2025) referenced by management. Payroll records showing actual founder compensation versus market rate. Prior-year compensation data to confirm the above-market differential is consistent.

adjustments.description: Planned headcount reduction of 14 FTE scheduled for Q1 FY2026. No notice has yet been served.
adjustments.management_rationale: Planned headcount reduction of 14 FTE scheduled for Q1 FY2026. No notice has yet been served.
adjustments.reasoning: Management explicitly states in the QoE schedule that (a) the headcount reduction is planned for Q1 FY2026, (b) no notice has yet been served, and (c) the savings have not yet been actioned. This is a prospective, future-period cost saving that has not occurred in the FY2025 analysis period. Adding back a cost saving that has not yet been achieved to FY2025 normalized EBITDA is inappropriate for a historical earnings quality analysis. The adjustment is not a normalization of an actual FY2025 cost — it is a forward-looking pro-forma projection. No structured data or VDR evidence supports that the headcount reduction has been implemented. The rejection is based on management's own disclosure that the event belongs to a future period and has not been actioned.

existence.detail: Management explicitly states the reduction is 'scheduled for Q1 FY2026' and 'no notice has yet been served.' The cost saving does not exist in FY2025.

amount.detail: $1,400,000 is management's estimate of future savings. No payroll data or headcount records are available to verify the amount. The amount is prospective and assumption-dependent.

period.detail: The savings relate to Q1 FY2026 and beyond. They do not belong in FY2025 normalized EBITDA.

recurrence.detail: No prior-period pro-forma cost savings adjustment appears in the structured data. This is the first occurrence.

duplication.detail: No other adjustment covers the same planned headcount reduction.

underlying_data.detail: No structured data supports that the headcount reduction has been implemented in FY2025. Subscription and revenue data shows continued growth through FY2025 with no cost reduction signal.

document_support.detail: Management QoE schedule (DOC-08) explicitly states 'Planned headcount reduction of 14 FTE scheduled for Q1 FY2026. No notice has yet been served.' This is management's own disclosure that the event is prospective and unactioned.

adjustments.what_would_raise_confidence: Evidence that the headcount reduction was actually implemented in FY2025 (e.g., termination notices, payroll records showing reduced headcount). Board resolution approving the restructuring with FY2025 effective dates.

adjustments.description: Trading losses on the Legacy On-Prem product, which is being sunset.
adjustments.management_rationale: Losses on Legacy On-Prem product being sunset.
adjustments.reasoning: The Legacy product family exists in the structured product dimension (PRD-016 'Legacy On-Prem Licence' and PRD-017 'Legacy Maintenance'). However, SQL-EV-007 and SQL-EV-021 return zero revenue from Legacy products in any period across all available invoice and invoice-line data. There is no structured evidence of Legacy product revenue or losses in FY2025 or any prior year. This creates a material evidential gap: management claims $540,000 of trading losses on this product line, but the transaction data shows no Legacy product activity at all. The underlying event (product sunset) is plausible given the product exists in the product dimension, but the absence of any Legacy product revenue or cost data in the structured sources means the $540,000 loss amount cannot be independently verified or contradicted. The adjustment is Challenged because: (1) the product exists in the product master, supporting the existence of the product line; (2) the absence of Legacy revenue in structured data is consistent with a product being wound down; but (3) the $540,000 loss amount has no structured data support and cannot be independently quantified; and (4) it is unclear whether the losses represent direct product costs, allocated overhead, or customer-specific write-offs. The accepted amount cannot be quantified without an unsupported assumption.

existence.detail: SQL-EV-006 confirms PRD-016 (Legacy On-Prem Licence) and PRD-017 (Legacy Maintenance) exist in dim_product. SQL-EV-007 and SQL-EV-021 return zero rows for Legacy product revenue across all invoice_line records in all periods.

amount.detail: $540,000 loss amount has no structured data support. No Legacy product revenue or cost records exist in fact_invoice_line. The loss composition (direct costs, allocated overhead, write-offs) is unknown.

period.detail: FY2025 is stated as the period. No transaction data exists to confirm or deny the period attribution.

adjustments.what_would_raise_confidence: Management accounts or cost ledger showing the composition of the $540,000 Legacy product losses. Evidence of Legacy product customer contracts or support obligations generating costs. Board or management decision document authorising the product sunset. Any invoice or cost record associated with PRD-016 or PRD-017.

adjustments.category: Pro-forma full-year effect of new logos
adjustments.description: Annualising the FY2025 in-year contribution of logos won during the year.
adjustments.reasoning: SQL-EV-009 confirms 20 customers with first_order_date in FY2025, generating $1,878,956 of FY2025 in-year revenue. The underlying new logo events are real and confirmed by structured data. However, the annualisation adjustment is Challenged for the following reasons: (1) Annualisation basis is assumption-dependent: management's $1,650,000 figure cannot be independently reconstructed from authoritative evidence without assuming a run-rate. The implied annualisation gap from active contracted ACV minus FY2025 revenue (SQL-EV-018) is approximately $799,620 — materially different from management's $1,650,000. This discrepancy cannot be resolved without understanding management's specific annualisation methodology. (2) Contract data quality issues: multiple new logo customers have contracts with end dates already expired (e.g., CUST-0143 Glenmoor Markets contract expired 2022-09-28, CUST-0145 Pinnacle Grocers expired 2025-02-28, CUST-0131 Silverbrook Brands expired 2022-04-28), raising questions about whether these customers have valid ongoing contractual commitments supporting annualisation. (3) Churned customers: SQL-EV-015 shows CUST-0143 (Glenmoor Markets) and CUST-0145 (Pinnacle Grocers) have churned status by December 2025, meaning their annualised contribution should not be included. (4) Cascade Foods Holdings (CUST-0006) dominates the new logo cohort with $1,206,022 of FY2025 revenue against a contracted ACV of $1,950,000 and an active contract through 2028-05-31. This customer's annualisation gap ($743,978) is independently supportable from the contracted ACV, but including it alone would not reach management's $1,650,000 figure. (5) The adjustment is a forward-looking normalization requiring assumptions about future revenue continuation that are not fully established by available evidence for the full cohort. The accepted amount cannot be quantified without resolving the methodology discrepancy and excluding churned customers.

existence.detail: SQL-EV-009 confirms 20 new logo customers with first_order_date in FY2025 generating $1,878,956 of FY2025 revenue. No pre-2025 invoice activity found for any of these customers (SQL-EV-017), confirming they are genuinely new logos.

amount.detail: Management states $1,650,000. SQL-EV-018 shows the ACV-based annualisation gap for active new logos with contracts extending beyond 2025 is approximately $799,620 — materially less than management's figure. The discrepancy cannot be resolved without management's specific annualisation methodology. The $1,650,000 amount is assumption-dependent and cannot be independently verified.

period.detail: New logos were won at various points during FY2025 (January through December). The partial-year revenue gap is real but the annualisation methodology and eligible customer set are unclear.

recurrence.detail: No prior-period new logo annualisation adjustment appears in FY2023 or FY2024 structured data.

duplication.detail: No other FY2025 adjustment covers new logo revenue. However, Cascade Foods Holdings (CUST-0006) is referenced in the CIM (DOC-01, page 14) as a notable FY2025 expansion. The CIM does not separately quantify this as an adjustment, so no duplication is identified.

underlying_data.detail: SQL-EV-016 shows new logo detail. Key issues: (a) CUST-0143 and CUST-0145 show churned status by Dec-2025 — their annualised contribution should be excluded; (b) multiple customers have expired contracts with no clear renewal evidence; (c) Cascade Foods Holdings has a strong active contract (ACV $1,950,000, active through 2028) supporting partial annualisation; (d) the remaining cohort has mixed contract quality. The implied annualisation gap from active, non-expired, non-churned contracts is approximately $799,620 per SQL-EV-018, but this itself requires an assumption that ACV equals annualised revenue.

document_support.detail: CIM (DOC-01, page 14) references Cascade Foods Holdings as a notable FY2025 expansion. DOC-06 (Cascade Foods MSA) confirms an active contract with ACV of $1,950,000 starting June 2025 through May 2028. No document supports the full $1,650,000 annualisation figure.

adjustments.what_would_raise_confidence: Management's detailed annualisation workings showing the specific customers included, the annualisation methodology (ACV-based, run-rate, or other), and the per-customer contribution to the $1,650,000. Executed contracts for all new logos confirming committed ARR. Clarification on whether churned customers (CUST-0143, CUST-0145) are included in the adjustment. Confirmation that Cascade Foods Holdings' partial-year gap is the primary driver.

If ADJ-007 and ADJ-010 are subsequently resolved and partially or fully accepted, Team Adjusted EBITDA would increase above $6,710,000.

sql_evidence.purpose: Total FY2025 in-year revenue from new logos

sql_evidence.purpose: Cascade Foods Holdings detail - largest new logo FY2025

sql_evidence.purpose: Subscription ARR for new FY2025 logos - status and ARR
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT fsm.customer_id, c.customer_name, MAX(fsm.snapshot_month) AS latest_snapshot, MAX(fsm.arr_usd) AS latest_arr_usd, fsm.status FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month fsm JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON fsm.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.first_order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND c.first_order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY fsm.customer_id, c.customer_name, fsm.status ORDER BY latest_arr_usd DESC

sql_evidence.purpose: New logo detail with contract and revenue data for annualisation analysis
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.first_order_date, MIN(fi.invoice_date) AS actual_first_invoice, MAX(fi.invoice_date) AS last_invoice_fy2025, SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) AS fy2025_revenue_usd, dc.acv_usd AS contracted_acv, dc.status AS contract_status, dc.contract_end_date FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON c.customer_id = fi.customer_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_contract dc ON c.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE c.first_order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND c.first_order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND fi.invoice_date >= '2025-01-01' AND fi.invoice_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.first_order_date, dc.acv_usd, dc.status, dc.contract_end_date ORDER BY fy2025_revenue_usd DESC
sql_evidence.result_summary: 20 new logo customers with FY2025 revenue detail. Multiple customers have expired contracts. Cascade Foods Holdings dominates at $1,206,022 FY2025 revenue vs $1,950,000 ACV.

sql_evidence.purpose: Check for pre-2025 invoice activity among new logo customers
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.first_order_date, COUNT(fi.invoice_id) AS pre_2025_invoice_count, SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) AS pre_2025_revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON c.customer_id = fi.customer_id WHERE c.first_order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND c.first_order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND fi.invoice_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.first_order_date ORDER BY pre_2025_revenue_usd DESC
sql_evidence.result_summary: Zero rows returned. No pre-2025 invoice activity found for any new logo customer. All 20 customers are genuinely new to the invoice record in FY2025.

sql_evidence.purpose: ACV-based annualisation gap for active new logos with contracts beyond FY2025
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT SUM(dc.acv_usd) AS total_acv_active_new_logos, SUM(CASE WHEN fi_sum.fy2025_rev IS NOT NULL THEN fi_sum.fy2025_rev ELSE 0 END) AS total_fy2025_revenue, SUM(dc.acv_usd) - SUM(CASE WHEN fi_sum.fy2025_rev IS NOT NULL THEN fi_sum.fy2025_rev ELSE 0 END) AS implied_annualisation_gap FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_contract dc ON c.customer_id = dc.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_id, SUM(invoice_amount_usd) AS fy2025_rev FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice WHERE invoice_date >= '2025-01-01' AND invoice_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customer_id) fi_sum ON c.customer_id = fi_sum.customer_id WHERE c.first_order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND c.first_order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND dc.status = 'Active' AND dc.contract_end_date > '2025-12-31'
sql_evidence.result_summary: Active new logo ACV: $2,248,981. FY2025 revenue from same cohort: $1,449,360. Implied ACV-based annualisation gap: $799,620. This is materially less than management's $1,650,000 figure.

sql_evidence.purpose: Final bridge validation
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT 4280000 AS reported_ebitda_usd, 8120000 AS mgmt_total_adjustments_usd, 4280000 + 8120000 AS mgmt_adjusted_ebitda_usd, 2430000 AS accepted_adjustments_total_usd, 2100000 + 1400000 AS total_rejected_usd, 540000 + 1650000 AS total_challenged_null_usd, 8120000 - 2430000 AS total_not_accepted_usd, 4280000 + 2430000 AS team_adjusted_ebitda_usd, 12400000 - (4280000 + 2430000) AS earnings_challenge_usd, CASE WHEN (4280000 + 8120000) = 12400000 THEN 'RECONCILES' ELSE 'DOES NOT RECONCILE' END AS mgmt_bridge_status, CASE WHEN (4280000 + 2430000) = 6710000 THEN 'RECONCILES' ELSE 'DOES NOT RECONCILE' END AS team_bridge_status
sql_evidence.result_summary: Management bridge: RECONCILES ($12,400,000). Team bridge: RECONCILES ($6,710,000). Earnings challenge: $5,690,000. Total rejected: $3,500,000. Total challenged null: $2,190,000.

unresolved_items.description: ADJ-007 (Discontinued product line, $540,000): Legacy products exist in dim_product but have zero invoice line activity in any period. The $540,000 loss amount cannot be verified or quantified from available structured data. Accepted amount remains null.
unresolved_items.impact: ADJ-007 is Challenged with null accepted amount. $540,000 is excluded from Team Adjusted EBITDA pending resolution.
unresolved_items.resolution: Provide management accounts or cost ledger showing composition of Legacy product losses. Provide any invoice or cost record associated with PRD-016 or PRD-017.

unresolved_items.description: ADJ-010 (Pro-forma new logos, $1,650,000): Management's annualisation methodology is not disclosed. The ACV-based annualisation gap for active new logos is $799,620 — materially less than $1,650,000. Two new logo customers (CUST-0143, CUST-0145) have churned. Multiple customers have expired contracts. Accepted amount remains null.
unresolved_items.impact: ADJ-010 is Challenged with null accepted amount. $1,650,000 is excluded from Team Adjusted EBITDA pending resolution.
unresolved_items.resolution: Provide management's detailed annualisation workings with per-customer breakdown and methodology. Clarify which customers are included and confirm churned customers are excluded.

unresolved_items.description: ADJ-008 (FY2024, Aborted refinancing costs, $180,000) exists in structured data but is absent from the management QoE schedule. It is a historical adjustment not applied to FY2025 and does not affect the FY2025 bridge, but the omission from the QoE schedule is an unexplained inconsistency.
unresolved_items.impact: No impact on FY2025 EBITDA bridge. Inconsistency noted for completeness.
unresolved_items.resolution: Management to confirm whether ADJ-008 was intentionally omitted from the QoE schedule and whether it was applied in the FY2024 reported EBITDA.

unresolved_items.description: Third-party compensation benchmark (Sep-2025) referenced in ADJ-004 is not present in the data room. The $1,250,000 owner compensation normalisation amount cannot be independently verified.
unresolved_items.impact: ADJ-004 accepted at management amount with reduced confidence (0.72). If the benchmark shows a different market rate, the accepted amount may need revision.
unresolved_items.resolution: Provide the third-party compensation benchmark document dated September 2025.

data_quality.description: Legacy products (PRD-016, PRD-017) exist in dim_product but have zero associated revenue in fact_invoice_line across all periods. This may indicate the products were never invoiced through the structured billing system, or that the invoice line data is incomplete for legacy billing.
data_quality.impact: Cannot independently verify ADJ-007 Legacy product losses from structured data.

data_quality.description: Multiple new logo customers (first_order_date in FY2025) have dim_contract records with contract_end_date in prior years (e.g., 2022, 2023, 2024), suggesting either stale contract records or that these customers are operating without current executed contracts.
data_quality.impact: Reduces reliability of ACV-based annualisation for ADJ-010. Contracts with expired end dates cannot support forward-looking annualisation.

data_quality.description: IT Systems Overview (DOC-10) notes that revenue reporting is prepared in spreadsheets from manual SQL extracts maintained by one analyst, with no data warehouse. This creates systemic data quality risk across all structured sources.
data_quality.impact: Reduces overall confidence in structured data completeness and accuracy. Particularly relevant for Legacy product data gaps.

validation.bridge_note: Team Adjusted EBITDA of $6,710,000 reflects quantified accepted adjustments only. ADJ-007 and ADJ-010 are Challenged with null accepted amounts and excluded from the bridge. Resolution of these items could increase Team Adjusted EBITDA.
